market_name: Will 2 Fed rate cuts happen in 2026?

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Check whether the probability move on the '2 cuts' strike is accompanied by moves in adjacent strikes (0,1,3+ cuts) to infer whether the shift is dovish or hawkish; watch fed funds futures (SOFR/ZQ) for corroboration.
time_plan.1h: Compare TLT and 2y/10y yields to see if Treasuries moved in the implied direction; confirm no scheduled Fed speaker or data print explains it.
time_plan.2h: Reassess whether any move is fading (noise) or sustained; check if a macro headline made this already public.
time_plan.6h: Evaluate cumulative TLT move vs the modest expected magnitude; downgrade if flat.
time_plan.12h: Close out research view: record realized TLT return and whether the prediction-market shift led or lagged rates.

predictions.reasoning: A shift in the implied probability of exactly two 25bp Fed cuts in 2026 maps to changes in the expected path of the fed funds rate, which drives long-duration Treasury prices. More expected cuts (dovish) lifts TLT; fewer (hawkish) lowers it. But 'exactly 2 cuts' is a non-monotonic strike — a probability rise could reflect the market pricing OUT a more-dovish scenario (3+ cuts) just as easily as pricing IN cuts versus zero. Direction is therefore genuinely ambiguous without knowing which tail moved. Over a 12h window the rate-path repricing implied is small relative to the 700bp tradable bar.

predictions.tradable_instrument_name: Invesco DB US Dollar Index Bullish Fund

trade_eligibility.reason: Below minimum expected move or unclear direction.

time_plan.30m: Confirm direction of the underlying rate-path shift from adjacent strikes and SOFR futures before assigning USD direction.
time_plan.1h: Check DXY / UUP against the implied hawkish/dovish read; verify no separate FX catalyst (ECB/BoJ, data).
time_plan.6h: Review whether USD move aligns with Treasury move (consistency check).
time_plan.12h: Record realized UUP return and lead/lag relationship to the market.

predictions.reasoning: Rate-cut expectations are a primary FX driver: fewer expected cuts (higher-for-longer) tends to strengthen USD, more cuts weakens it. As with rates, the 'exactly 2 cuts' strike is non-monotonic so directional read is weak. FX moves from a marginal shift in 2026 cut odds are typically well under 1% intraday, far below the 700bp tradable threshold.

evidence_used: Market resolves on count of 25bp FOMC cuts in 2026, a direct read on the expected fed funds path
Fed rate expectations are the mechanical driver of Treasury yields, USD, and duration-sensitive assets
12h window and 700bp tradable threshold constrain which moves can qualify
uncertainty_notes: The 'exactly 2 cuts' strike is non-monotonic: a probability increase can be dovish or hawkish depending on which neighboring scenario lost probability
Prediction-market rate odds usually lag or track liquid rate futures rather than leak new information
No specific anomaly magnitude was provided, so directional confidence is low

llm_justification.summary: This market is a proxy for the 2026 Fed easing path. Sharp moves in the implied odds map most directly to US rate-sensitive assets — long Treasuries (TLT) and the dollar (UUP). However, the 'exactly 2 cuts' strike is non-monotonic, so a probability move does not cleanly signal a dovish or hawkish shift without examining adjacent strikes and rate futures. Expected 12h magnitudes are small (tens of bps), well below the 700bp tradable bar, so we treat both mappings as unclear/low-confidence research signals rather than actionable trades.
key_assumptions: The prediction-market move reflects a genuine change in expected Fed policy path rather than thin-market noise
Treasuries and USD respond in the standard direction to rate-path repricing
Rate futures markets provide the disambiguating signal for dovish vs hawkish
failure_modes: Direction misread because the strike is non-monotonic (probability up could be a hawkish repricing of a dovish tail)
The information is already public and priced into far-more-liquid SOFR/fed funds futures, so no leak/edge exists
Proxy weakness: broad macro news or overseas catalysts dominate TLT/UUP over any 2026-cut-odds signal
Move is noise and mean-reverts within the 12h window
Magnitude far below the 700bp threshold, so even a correct direction is not tradable
llm_justification.why_not_ex_post: The card is timestamped, content-hashed, and never overwritten. Execution must reject any card created after an anomaly's trigger time.
